{{incomplete|needs=Catalogue numbers, disc divisions}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eighteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S18|Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Partial collections== Two ''Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest'' DVD sets were released in 2016 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}, containing the whole season between them. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. ===Set 1=== [[File:XY Kalos Quest Set 1.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Set 1]] Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Set 1 was released on July 12, 2016.
